comparisons.reason: The constructs differ. Item 0 asks whether any comment explicitly challenges an underlying assumption or premise of the OP's view, which is a semantic argumentative judgment. Item 1 asks whether any comment contains a verbatim or near-verbatim quotation of OP title or body text, and it explicitly says endorsement or refutation is irrelevant. A comment can quote the OP without challenging any premise, and a comment can challenge a premise without quoting. The null rules also differ.
